summary: PASS — All 4 PDF/Quote-Preview fixes verified on SA-260617-163552-TEST (Simple multi-qty, qtys 500/1000/2000, Die+Freight+Clips line charges) and SA-260604-165816-COPY (Multi-Part·3 Matched Set). (1) MP Matched Set has NO 'View Kit Matrix' button (open-kit-matrix count=0) and no kit-matrix modal in DOM. (3) By Part renders separate columns Die | Freight | Clips with '—' for missing types (500-tier shows '—' in Die). (4) Lump Sum renders one descriptive line per qty tier under data-testid='preview-lumpsum-charges' with lines 'Freight + Clips @ Qty 500: $652.14', 'Freight + Die + Clips @ Qty 1,000: $2,168.77', 'Freight + Die + Clips @ Qty 2,000: $2,553.28'. (2) Across all three modes each tier reflects only the charges that apply (500 tier has NO die anywhere). By Type regression: single combined 'Charges' column unchanged.

item1_mp_matched_set_no_kit_matrix.frontend_src_grep: no matches for open-kit-matrix / KitMatrixModal / 'View Kit Matrix' anywhere in /app/frontend/src

item3_by_part_separate_columns.note: Custom misc-name 'Clips' correctly rendered as its own column alongside Die/Freight (not bucketed into Misc). Tier 500 correctly shows '—' for Die since no die charge applies at that tier.

critical_code_review_comments: PreviewPdfModal.jsx PricingTable (L402-547) correctly toggles three layouts via chargeMode: byPart computes colDie/colFrt/colPrep flags from rows.some(...) and dynamically discovers miscNames from r.miscLineItems[].name with a 'Misc' fallback when only miscLineCost is present. The thead and tbody both gate columns on the same flags so headers always align with cells. Quote Total = r.itemSell + (die+freight+prep+sum(misc)) — confirmed correct on live data.

Lump Sum descriptive list (L517-544) maps rows → {qty, label, sum} filtered by sum>0, so empty-charge tiers wouldn't render a row (correct). chargeLabel() builds parts only when the corresponding charge value > 0, producing the variable label per tier (e.g. 'Freight + Clips' for qty 500 because Die=0 there, 'Freight + Die + Clips' for qtys 1000/2000). Misc items joined by name (Clips) not 'Misc', so custom names appear in both By Part columns and Lump Sum labels — consistent behavior.

QuoteTableSec.jsx — no remaining references to KitMatrixModal / open-kit-matrix / 'View Kit Matrix'; the modal component and its trigger button have been completely removed (grep -rn returns 0 matches across /app/frontend/src).

Minor: default chargeMode is hardcoded 'By Type' (L34). Acceptable since the request says By Type is the legacy/unchanged default. No persistence between opens — each modal open resets to By Type, which is fine for a preview-only control.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing SA-260617-163552-TEST PDF LINE ITEMS (Simple, qtys 500/1000/2000, Die+Freight+Clips line charges) and SA-260604-165816-COPY (Multi-Part Matched Set, 3 components).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-verify these 4 fixes: login admin → click the SA-260604-165816-COPY tab and confirm 0 elements with data-testid='open-kit-matrix' (MP Matched Set) → click the SA-260617-163552-TEST tab → click [data-testid='toolbar-preview'] to open the Quote Preview modal → use [data-testid='preview-charges-by-type' | 'preview-charges-by-part' | 'preview-charges-lump-sum'] to switch modes. In By Part check that the table thead contains 'Die', 'Freight', and 'Clips' as separate columns (not a single 'Charges' col) and that the 500-qty row shows '—' under Die. In Lump Sum check [data-testid='preview-lumpsum-charges'] exists and [data-testid='preview-lumpsum-line-0/1/2'] each render '<types> + ... @ Qty <n> $<sum>'. In By Type check the header still has a single 'Charges' column and the lumpsum block is absent.
rca of the issue: Not a bug fix — this iteration validated 4 presentational changes implemented by E1: (a) removal of the redundant 'View Kit Matrix' affordance from QuoteTableSec.jsx (KitMatrixModal component + trigger button deleted, including data-testid='open-kit-matrix'); (b) PreviewPdfModal.jsx PricingTable now branches on chargeMode={'Lump Sum'|'By Type'|'By Part'} where (i) By Part dynamically discovers Die/Freight/Prepress/miscNames columns from row data via rows.some(r => Number(r.dieLineCost||0) > 0) etc. and per-row miscLineItems[].name, (ii) By Type retains the single combined Charges column (legacy), (iii) Lump Sum hides the Charges column entirely and renders a per-tier descriptive list below the table with data-testid='preview-lumpsum-line-{i}', where the label is constructed by joining only the charge TYPES whose values are >0 for that tier — which automatically gives 'Freight + Clips' for qty 500 (no Die) and 'Freight + Die + Clips' for qtys 1000/2000. Backend pdf.py (~L380) mirrors the same three-mode behaviour for the exported PDF and was not separately re-tested per E1's instruction (Print uses the modal DOM directly so the on-screen verification covers the Print path).
